population.span: The CANVAS Program integrated data from two trials involving a total of 10,142 participants with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk.

endpoint.span: amputations were primarily at the level of the toe or metatarsal

estimate.span: an increased risk of amputation (6.3 vs. 3.4 participants per 1000 patient-years; hazard ratio, 1.97; 95% CI, 1.41 to 2.75)

ci.span: an increased risk of amputation (6.3 vs. 3.4 participants per 1000 patient-years; hazard ratio, 1.97; 95% CI, 1.41 to 2.75)

treatment_strategy.span: Participants in each trial were randomly assigned to receive canagliflozin or placebo

follow_up.span: were followed for a mean of 188.2 weeks

absent_reason.analysis_set: The abstracts do not state the analysis population for amputation; the only held registry record (NCT01032629, CANVAS only) reports no amputation outcome, and the CANVAS-R registry record (NCT01989754) is not held.

served_mismatch: Served number (HR 1.97, 1.41-2.75) matches the source. Two label issues: (1) the source names the endpoint 'amputation', not 'lower-limb amputation'; lower-limb is implied only by 'primarily at the level of the toe or metatarsal', so the served label goes slightly beyond the text. (2) The served analysis_set 'trial-wide randomized/safety cohort' is not stated in any held source.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults with type 2 diabetes and high CV risk in a CV-outcome programme. Held sources do not report baseline heart-failure status, so the 'with and without baseline HF' part of the question is not stated.
entry_population_matches_question.span: 65.6% had a history of cardiovascular disease

notes: CANVAS Program: integrated CANVAS + CANVAS-R, pooled estimate. The records.json abstract and europepmc_core.json are identical; bound to records.json. The abstract gives no dose (the CANVAS registry lists canagliflozin 100 mg and 300 mg arms, but that registry covers only one of the two trials). No per-arm event counts are printed; the rates 6.3 vs 3.4 per 1000 patient-years are in the estimate span. Mean follow-up of 188.2 weeks is programme-wide.
